fv_method: Scenario FV on FY2026 guided economics (GBP27.2M revenue / GBP2.15M PBT), NOT on the screened TTM. Deliberately NOT acted on: the ~6.5pp nominal expected edge is inside the 10-15% all-in round-trip friction, i.e. the edge is negative net of execution before any risk adjustment.
plan: NO POSITION. PASS on friction alone would be legitimate and the fundamental refutation makes it overdetermined. Do not stage, do not ladder, do not take a token starter. A 0.75% UK position ($24,750 = GBP18,410) exceeds one day's 20%-of-median-volume order cap (GBP16,900), the quoted round trip is 8.6% before impact (realistically 10-15%), the displayed offer is good for about GBP2,550 (NMS 30,000 shares), and a GBP9,796 director purchase moved the price 16.3% today. Re-court ONLY if all three hold: (a) FY2027 revenue guided above GBP35M EX-Siemens, (b) touch inside ~300bp on median turnover above GBP400k/day, (c) the capitalised-development balance stops growing. Absent (b) the fundamentals are irrelevant at this book.
catalyst: FY2026 full-year results, September 2026 (y/e 30-Apr-2026) - the print that reveals whether H2 was loss-making. No Notice of Results RNS issued yet; historical cadence puts it in late Aug / early Sept. Watch-only, not an entry catalyst.

edge_explainer: IDENTITY RESOLVED FIRST per the ELE lesson: Kromek Group plc, co. 08661469, Sedgefield - CZT radiation-detection semiconductors, split Advanced Imaging (medical SPECT) and CBRN Detection (homeland security/defence). ISIN GB00BD7V5D43 matches the shelf row. THE MICROSTRUCTURE IS THE COURT AND IT FAILS ON ITS OWN: 859bp quoted touch (7.8/8.5) is the widest of 249 shelf names, median daily turnover is GBP85,243, Normal Market Size is 30,000 shares = GBP2,550, and a 0.75% UK position (GBP18,410) is LARGER than the 20%-of-a-median-day order cap (GBP16,900) - so a full position cannot be built inside the house rule in a single session, let alone exited. The decisive tape datum, verified today: on 03-Aug the chairman filed a Director Share Purchase for 129,413 shares at 7.57p = GBP9,796, and on 04-Aug the stock closed 8.40p, +16.3% from 7.22p, on an 18% intraday range. A nine-thousand-seven-hundred-pound order set the marginal price. A buyer today would lift a 8.50p offer ABOVE the close, immediately after a 16% rip, at +75% off the 52-week low (4.80p, 03-Sep-2025) and -33% off the 26-Jan-2026 peak of 12.55p - the shelf's own entry_exhausted flag was right. THE HEADLINE IS ALSO A TTM SPLICE ARTIFACT. Kromek's fiscal year ends 30 APRIL, so the screen's TTM to 31-Oct-2025 ends at an interim balance-sheet date. It ties arithmetically (FY2025 + H1 FY2026 - H1 FY2025 = GBP37.81M revenue / GBP12.74M operating profit) but the window simultaneously double-counts a one-off and DELETES a -GBP4.8M half-year: roughly half the celebrated flip from -GBP1.9M to +GBP12.7M is just the removal of six bad months. The profit is one named contract - the Siemens Healthineers Enablement Agreement signed 30-Jan-2025, $37.5M over four years, of which GBP16.5M was recognised in FY2025 and GBP8.3M in H1 FY2026. The tell is that FY2025 cost of sales FELL from GBP8,693k to GBP5,075k while revenue rose 37%, taking gross margin from 55.2% to 80.9% - a CZT hardware maker does not earn 81% gross margin; a licence fee does. Strip Siemens and FY2025 revenue nearly halved (ex-Siemens ~GBP10.0M vs GBP19.4M in FY2024, with CBRN falling GBP10.4M to GBP6.2M). And the company already published the run-rate: the 12-May-2026 trading update states FY2026 consensus of GBP27.2M revenue and GBP2.15M PBT - revenue ~28% below the screen and profit ~6x below - which on a GBP55.0M cap and ~GBP3.4M net debt is ~27x EV/PBT. Reported H1 PBT of GBP3.1M against GBP2.15M full-year guidance implies an H2 operating LOSS. 'AT BOOK' IS ALSO REFUTED: GBP32.2M of the GBP56.9M equity is capitalised development cost, so tangible book is ~GBP21.3M and the stock trades at ~2.6x tangible, not 0.97x - and this is the auditor's own second key audit matter (risk 'particularly heightened where products being developed have not yet been commercialized'), with GBP13.2M of it in an uncommercialised Biological-Threat Detection CGU valued on ten-year forecasts. The auditor's FIRST key audit matter is revenue recognition on the same 'highly material contract'. Both of HaysMac's flagged risks are precisely the two pillars of the screen's ranking. THE DURABILITY-WATCH RESCUE IS REFUTED: the shelf rescued KMK because it 'generated cash on both sides of the EBIT cross', but statutory FY2024 operating cash flow was NEGATIVE GBP2.8M - the guard can only have been computed on FY2025 plus H1 FY2026, i.e. the two periods that both contain Siemens, so the durability test was run on the artifact it existed to catch. Encodable generator bug: cash_generative_2y must span the same lookback as the EBIT history it rescues. Nor is the GBP12.65M of 'FCF' free: GBP6,547k of FY2025's GBP15,901k operating cash flow is a receivables release reversing a GBP7,454k prior-year build, the screen dropped the GBP4,279k of capitalised development that is Kromek's dominant capex line, and the entire proceeds went to lenders (GBP12.9M repaid to Polymer N2 Ltd in Feb-2025) leaving GBP1.248M of cash. TWO MORE SCREEN REFUTATIONS: shares have gone 344.9M to 655,299,911 (+90% since Feb-2021, last raise at 5p, plus a 1p debt-for-equity issue to the lender) with a 65,716,556-share option/LTIP overhang = 10.0% that the company's OWN results RNS understates as 5.5% by excluding the 30.5M penny-struck LTIP; and 'zero analysts' is wrong - Cavendish is retained Nomad and Broker and publishes the consensus the company itself cites, so the name is DISCOVERING (it tripled on retail/media pickup in Dec-25/Jan-26 and is now unwinding) rather than an undiscovered orphan, and there is no neglect discount to harvest. HONESTY GRADE CLEAN - the company is not the liar, the screen is. Kromek named the contract, its value and its receipt dates in standalone RNS, volunteered the GBP1.4M of Siemens one-off costs, the GBP1.3M bad-debt provision and the GBP0.6M R&D tax credit sitting in administrative expenses, printed the CBRN revenue decline in its highlights, explicitly flagged 'the exceptional contribution from the Siemens Healthineers agreement' on 12-May-2026 while publishing consensus, and disclosed in the annual report that its plausible worst-case scenario 'indicates a requirement for the Group to obtain additional finance'. Re-detecting an honestly disclosed one-off is not alpha. RULING: not a de-rate and not a derailment - the cheapness never existed, so there is no multiple to compress. Three independently sufficient grounds to pass: friction, a refuted headline, and a refuted book. What may be real is that ex-Siemens revenue is genuinely accelerating (~GBP10.0M in FY2025 to an implied ~GBP17.8M in FY2026 on CBRN recovery and the European defence cycle) - but that is a growth story at 27x guided PBT with a 10% penny-struck overhang, undisclosed RCF covenants and GBP1.2M of cash, and it is not expressible at this book at 10-15% round-trip friction. If the thesis is European defence there are a dozen instruments that cost 20bp to trade. CROSS-NAME LESSON: both LSE top-15 names courted today grade company-clean / screen-wrong by two distinct encodable generator defects - KMK is a vendor TTM splice across a fiscal-year boundary that double-counts a one-off and deletes a loss period; CAML is a perpetuity EV/EBIT applied to a finite-life extractive annuity.
unverifiable: MOST IMPORTANT: HSBC RCF covenants and exact maturity - never disclosed anywhere. The three-year GBP6.0M facility post-dates the FY2025 accounts, whose note 34 ('not subject to any externally imposed capital requirements') is therefore stale. On GBP1.2M of cash with a going-concern downside case that requires new money, an undisclosed covenant package on the only committed facility is the largest unknown in the file.
Recoverability of the GBP32.2M capitalised development, especially the GBP13.2M Biological-Threat Detection CGU valued on ten-year forecasts of uncommercialised programmes - untestable from outside.
The remaining $7.5M of the Siemens contract: timing, recognition profile, and whether any milestone is conditional.
The structure of the GBP1.14M August-2022 'Fundraising' (presumed further convertible loan notes) - announcement not opened.
Whether H2 FY2026 was actually loss-making - inferred from guidance minus reported H1; resolves at the September 2026 print.
No independent (non-house-broker) forecast located; Cavendish is retained and paid by the issuer.
